title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Bryson-DeChambeau Leverage
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the PGA Tour's Charles Schwab Challenge field is underwhelming with stars missing, while they play LIV in Korea; DeChambeau is considering YouTube full-time and only majors as he negotiates a PGA Tour return.

items.headline: Soo Bin Joo’s LPGA Lead
items.text: Soo Bin Joo shot 3-under 68 amid seaside winds at the ShopRite LPGA, two-putt birdied the 18th, and expanded her lead to four strokes at 8-under 134 with just one bogey after two rounds.
